prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE exquisitely designed architectural concept presentation board for a cozy two-storey wooden meadow cottage game. This is a substantial ARCHITECTURAL REDESIGN of the tiny box cabin. The supplied four-panel image is a reference ONLY for restrained matte stylized 3D art, sage grass, lavender-blue atmosphere and quiet dreamcore mood; do NOT preserve the crude rectangular shed shape. User explicitly wants a beautiful refined cabin with generous terrace, real windows, and a usable second floor.
LAYOUT: large landscape board 3:2 ratio on warm ivory paper, carefully organized, no decorative graphic noise. Left approximately 62%: one large polished three-quarter front exterior hero render with a little meadow and a rising grassy mountain foot behind, airy soft early-evening light, entire building roof-to-ground visible. Right upper: smaller opposite rear/side three-quarter view of exactly the SAME building on plain ivory background. Right lower: coherent architectural cutaway axonometric showing actual ground floor, stair, upstairs and roof relation of exactly the SAME building. Three views total on ONE board. Small tasteful typography labels only: 'LINLU CABIN', '01 / EXTERIOR', '02 / REAR VIEW', '03 / SECTION'. No fabricated measurements, plans, illegible annotations or logo. Balanced generous margins.
ARCHITECTURE: refined contemporary alpine timber cottage, natural human scale, approximately 10 by 12 metre building mass as a concept only, substantial ground floor plus real usable second floor nested partly beneath a pitched roof. Asymmetrical composition with a taller primary gabled volume, a slightly lower projecting cross-gable bay, and a small lower side volume; restrained intersecting roof forms, not dozens of chaotic gables. Weathered light honey/cream timber walls with subtle broad plank divisions, darker exposed timber posts and knee braces, slate blue grey metal roof with clean seams and deep eaves, low warm grey stone plinth, one modest stone chimney aligned with interior hearth. A generous wraparound wooden ground-floor terrace across the front and one side, wide shallow approach steps, visibly supported deck, covered porch along part of terrace with believable posts, remaining open sun deck for two wooden chairs and a small table. Delicate well-proportioned timber railing where needed, integrated seating and a few flower planters. Elegant main entrance offset beneath sheltered porch with a glazed timber door, a small wall lantern, clearly reachable from steps.
WINDOW DESIGN: generous subdivided picture window at ground-floor living room, a projecting reading-window bay with a window seat, operable smaller side windows with tasteful timber frames, one carefully placed dormer, a tall gable window upstairs. A small sheltered upstairs balcony recessed into the FRONT gable, directly accessible from upstairs double glazed doors, supported by the porch structural system; upstairs sleeping room and reading nook visibly real, not fake windows pasted onto a roof. Consistent door, balcony, dormer and chimney positions across views.
CUTAWAY: cut away the near exterior walls/part of the roof to reveal a plausible ground floor living area with hearth, kitchen/dining and actual stair rising with a landing to an upper bedroom/reading landing and balcony door; floor slabs, stairs and balcony connection should be readable. Preserve the exterior roof silhouette where possible. Use simple quiet furnishings, no dollhouse clutter.
STYLE: premium stylized 3D game art, beautifully designed and refined through silhouette, proportions, layered structure and thoughtful joinery, NOT photorealism or high-frequency wood textures. Soft matte color blocks, subtle bevels, readable modelable forms, low visual noise. Broad shapes and reusable architectural details. Warm soft interior glow only in selected windows, cool gently shaded roof, natural herbaceous grass and sparse small white/lilac flowers. House dominates, vegetation doesn't hide architecture. No log fortress, no toy proportions, no ornate fantasy palace, no flat matchbox, no excessive bokeh, no sunset orange filter, no heavy oil painting, no snow covering the house, no people. A designed home one wants to live in, precise, charming, quiet and exceptionally considered.
